Which statement about the angle $\theta$ opposite the $10$ side is correct?

Find all possible lengths of $BC$, correct to $1$ decimal place.

questions.solution_text:

$\sin C=\dfrac{8\sin30^{\circ}}{5}=0.8$
$C_1=\sin^{-1}(0.8)\approx53.1301^{\circ}$
$C_2=180^{\circ}-C_1\approx126.8699^{\circ}$
$126.8699^{\circ}+30^{\circ}<180^{\circ}$, so both are valid.

$BC\approx9.9$ cm or $3.9$ cm.
